services.name: Personal Training
services.desc: Private coaching sessions at CrossFit ATR San Diego built around your goals, your schedule, and your life. No templates, no generic plans, just coaching that actually fits. Personal Training at CrossFit ATR gives you the full attention of one of our certified coaches in a completely private setting. Every session is built around your specific goals, movement history, and lifestyle. No templates, no guesswork. services.name: Massage Therapy
services.desc: In-house sports massage at CrossFit ATR in San Diego led by James Rhodes, HHP, CMT. Eight plus years working with elite athletes to reduce injury risk and speed up recovery. Recovery is often the first thing to get skipped when life gets busy, but it's just as important as the training itself. CrossFit ATR's massage therapy program removes that barrier by embedding sports massage directly inside the gym, so recovery becomes part of your routine instead of one more errand. James Rhodes, HHP, CMT is the founder of Dynamic Recovery & Performance Massage Services, LLC and brings over eight years of experience in sports massage and recovery.
